import os
import math
import numpy as np
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.robot as viper
from pychrono import irrlicht as chronoirr

# Create Chrono system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)
system.SetGravitationalAcceleration(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -9.81))  # Set gravity in the negative Z direction
chrono.ChCollisionModel.SetDefaultSuggestedEnvelope(0.0025)
chrono.ChCollisionModel.SetDefaultSuggestedMargin(0.0025)

# Create ground body
ground_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
ground = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(20, 20, 1, 1000, True, True, ground_mat)
ground.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -1))  # Position the ground slightly below the origin
ground.SetFixed(True)  # Fix the ground in place
# Set ground texture for visualization
ground.GetVisualShape(0).SetTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("textures/concrete.jpg"))
system.Add(ground)

# Create Viper rover
rover = viper.Viper(system)  # Instantiate the Viper rover
driver = viper.ViperDCMotorControl()  # Create a driver for the rover
rover.SetDriver(driver)  # Assign the driver to the rover

# Initialize rover position and orientation
init_pos = chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0.2, 0)
init_rot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)
rover.Initialize(chrono.ChFramed(init_pos, init_rot))

# Create run-time visualization
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AttachSystem(system)
vis.SetCameraVertical(chrono.CameraVerticalDir_Z)
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 720)
vis.SetWindowTitle('Viper rover - Rigid terrain')
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 2.5, 1.5), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 1))
vis.AddTypicalLights()
vis.AddLightWithShadow(chrono.ChVector3d(1.5, -2.5, 5.5), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.5), 3, 4, 10, 40, 512)

# Enable shadows (commented out to improve performance)
# vis.EnableShadows()

# Set the simulation time step
time_step = 1e-3

# Simulation loop
time = 0
while vis.Run():
    time += time_step  # Increment the simulation time
    steering = 0
    max_steering = math.pi / 6  # Maximum steering angle
    
    # Define the steering behavior over time
    if 2 < time < 7:
        steering = max_steering * (time - 2) / 5  # Gradually increase steering
    elif 7 < time < 12:
        steering = max_steering * (12 - time) / 5  # Gradually decrease steering
    
    driver.SetSteering(steering)  # Set the steering for the rover

    rover.Update()  # Update the rover's state

    # Render the scene
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.Render()
    vis.EndScene()
    
    # Advance the simulation by one time step
    system.DoStepDynamics(time_step)

```python
import chrono
from chrono import ChVector, ChCoordsys, ChFrame, ChQuaternion, ChMatrix33
from chrono.irrlicht import *
from chrono.vehicle import *

# Initialize the PyChrono environment and core components
chrono.SetChDir('path/to/your/chrono/data/directory')
my_application = chrono.ChApplication()
my_application.SetSolverType(chrono.ChSolver.Type_PSS_DANTZIG)
my_application.Set_G_acc(ChVector(0, -9.81, 0))

# Add the required physical systems and objects as specified
my_system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# Ground body
ground_shape = chrono.ChBoxShape(1e7, 1e7, 1)
ground_body = chrono.ChBodyEasyCreate dynamics, ground_shape, 1000, chrono.ChVector(0, 0, 0)
my_system.AddBody(ground_body)

# Initialize the Viper rover and its driver
viper_filename = 'path/to/your/viper/model.obj'
viper_driver_filename = 'path/to/your/viper/driver.py'
viper_rover = chrono.ChVehicleNSC(viper_filename)
viper_driver = chrono.ChVehicleDriver(viper_driver_filename)
my_system.Add(viper_rover)
viper_rover.SetDriver(viper_driver)

# Create a real-time visualization using Irrlicht
my_vis = chrono.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
my_application.SetVisualSystem(my_vis)
my_vis.SetChaseCamera(chrono.ChVector(10, 10, 10), chrono.ChVector(0, 0, 0))
my_vis.SetBackfaceCulling(False)
my_vis.AddLogo()
my_vis.AddSkyBox()
my_vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVector(0, 15, -20), chrono.ChVector(0, 0, 0))

# Implement a simulation loop
duration = 10  # seconds
time_step = 1e-3  # seconds
timesteps = int(duration / time_step)
steering_time = 5  # seconds
steering_angle = 0.5  # radians
steering_start_time = timesteps // 2

for i in range(timesteps):
    if i >= steering_start_time and i < steering_start_time + (timesteps // (2 * steering_time)):
        steering_angle = 0.5 * (i - steering_start_time) / (timesteps // steering_time)
    else:
        steering_angle = 0.5 - 0.5 * abs((i - steering_start_time) / (timesteps // steering_time))

    viper_rover.GetVehicle().GetChassisBody().SetWvel(chrono.ChVector(0, 0, 0))
    viper_rover.GetVehicle().GetChassisBody().SetWrot(chrono.ChQuaternion(1, 0, 0, 0))
    viper_rover.GetVehicle().SetSteer(steering_angle)

    my_system.DoStepDynamics(time_step)
    my_application.DoStepVisualization(time_step, my_vis)

# Finalize the simulation
my_vis.WaitKey(0)
del my_application
```
